info.title: intrusion_detection
info.description: Recognises attacks on logins, shares and accounts, and answers them with graduated, explained responses.

get.summary: What intrusion detection is doing right now
get.description:
The state (protecting, learning or off), the last 24 hours in numbers, the prerequisites, the measured cost of the address check and the problems to show under the status banner.
This endpoint requires admin access

post.summary: Block an address or a network by hand
post.description:
Accepts an IPv4 address, an IPv4 /24 network, or an IPv6 address or /64 network (an IPv6 address is blocked with its /64). Your own address, the server and addresses on the brute-force allowlist cannot be blocked.
This endpoint requires admin access
This endpoint requires password confirmation

get.summary: Look up a block reference, an address or an account
get.description:
A reference (like K7Q2-MPXA, in any case, with or without the dash) returns its block; an address returns the blocks covering it and its recent detections; an account returns the recent detections about it.
This endpoint requires admin access
